sets.text: So this time, I went and see my brother again, [b]he just told me to not trust the forum...[/b]

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: And I met a few (community name) members along the way too, [b]I can tell they're really worried about me.[/b]

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: Almost everyone I met [b]asked about what I'm doing for my brother.[/b]

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: John
sets.text: Honestly..., I still haven't figured that out yet.

choices.text: You said they're worried, what do you think they are afraid of?

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: They probably worried and just trying to avoid any further trouble.

responses.speaker: N1

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Maybe they're worried because I am following this path, and think I can still come back.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: But I really don't know if they're understanding what I'm going through...

choices.text: Let's say you're in your brother's shoes, would you feel the same?

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Well... I guess I would be concerned to not let a brother get hurt.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: But it's also that I don't think he does understand the situation yet, it's conflicting...

choices.text: Why do you think they are so concerned about you retaliating back?

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: Probably because that they don't want me to really end up badly and also caused some further trouble.

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: But I think there are things that are not clear here...

responses.speaker: N1
responses.name: John
responses.text: I suppose I still don't know whether they're worried about me, or whether they just don't agree with what I want to do.

sets.speaker: N1

sets.text: For (community name), I know what they say [b]can be right about some things[/b], there are definitely the good and bad.
